toefl:se:402.answer: In my opinion, digital content makes it easier for parents to raise children than before.
toefl:se:402.fullSentence: In my opinion, digital content makes it easier for parents to raise children than before.
keyPhrases: makes it easier for parents to raise children
toefl:se:402.japanese: 私の意見では、デジタルコンテンツのおかげで、以前よりも親が子育てをしやすくなっています。
toefl:se:402.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:402.explanation: make it easier for A to doで「Aが〜しやすくなる」という表現。
toefl:se:402.relatedInfo: In my view, / makes parenting easier than before
src: 子育てとデジタル技術1

toefl:se:403.answer: As Andrew mentioned, children can now learn new things like foreign languages, cooking, or history by watching videos on their digital devices.
toefl:se:403.fullSentence: As Andrew mentioned, children can now learn new things like foreign languages, cooking, or history by watching videos on their digital devices.
keyPhrases: by watching videos on their digital devices
toefl:se:403.japanese: アンドリューが述べていたように、子どもたちは今やデジタル機器で動画を見ることで、外国語や料理、歴史といった新しいことを学べるようになっています。
toefl:se:403.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:403.explanation: as A mentionedは「Aが述べたように」と他者の発言を引用する表現。
toefl:se:403.relatedInfo: as Andrew pointed out / as Andrew noted
src: 子育てとデジタル技術1

toefl:se:404.answer: This means parents do not always have to spend extra time or effort finding tutors or classes.
toefl:se:404.fullSentence: This means parents do not always have to spend extra time or effort finding tutors or classes.
keyPhrases: do not always have to spend extra time or effort
toefl:se:404.japanese: これは、親が家庭教師や教室を探すために余計な時間や労力を費やす必要が必ずしもなくなることを意味します。
toefl:se:404.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:404.explanation: do not always〜は「必ずしも〜とは限らない」という部分否定。
toefl:se:404.relatedInfo: don't necessarily need to / no longer have to always
src: 子育てとデジタル技術1

toefl:se:405.answer: Additionally, digital content can help parents and children find topics to discuss and share together, which can strengthen their connection.
toefl:se:405.fullSentence: Additionally, digital content can help parents and children find topics to discuss and share together, which can strengthen their connection.
keyPhrases: find topics to discuss and share together
toefl:se:405.japanese: さらに、デジタルコンテンツは親子が一緒に話し合い共有する話題を見つける助けとなり、それが二人の絆を強めることにもつながります。
toefl:se:405.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:405.explanation: help A doで「Aが〜するのを助ける」。which以下は関係代名詞の非制限用法。
toefl:se:405.relatedInfo: help them bond / deepen their relationship
src: 子育てとデジタル技術1

toefl:se:406.answer: However, it is still important for parents to monitor what their children are watching to make sure it is appropriate and educational.
toefl:se:406.fullSentence: However, it is still important for parents to monitor what their children are watching to make sure it is appropriate and educational.
keyPhrases: still important for parents to monitor
make sure it is appropriate and educational
toefl:se:406.japanese: しかし、それでも親は子どもが何を見ているかを確認し、それが適切で教育的な内容であるかを確かめることが重要です。
toefl:se:406.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:406.explanation: it is important for A to doで「Aが〜することが重要だ」という形式主語構文。
toefl:se:406.relatedInfo: keep track of what / ensure it is suitable
src: 子育てとデジタル技術1

toefl:se:407.answer: I would argue that raising children has become more difficult overall, despite the conveniences technology provides.
toefl:se:407.fullSentence: I would argue that raising children has become more difficult overall, despite the conveniences technology provides.
toefl:se:407.japanese: 私は、テクノロジーがもたらす便利さにもかかわらず、全体として子育てはより難しくなったと主張します。
toefl:se:407.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:407.explanation: despite+名詞句で「〜にもかかわらず」という譲歩を表す。
toefl:se:407.relatedInfo: I would contend that / in spite of the convenience technology offers
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:408.answer: First, modern parents face higher expectations.
toefl:se:408.fullSentence: First, modern parents face higher expectations.
toefl:se:408.japanese: 第一に、現代の親はより高い期待にさらされています。
toefl:se:408.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:408.explanation: face+名詞で「〜に直面する」という表現。
toefl:se:408.relatedInfo: are confronted with higher expectations / deal with greater expectations
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:409.answer: As Dr. Achebe mentions, they are supposed to be deeply involved in schoolwork, after-school activities, and emotional support.
toefl:se:409.fullSentence: As Dr. Achebe mentions, they are supposed to be deeply involved in schoolwork, after-school activities, and emotional support.
toefl:se:409.japanese: アチェベ博士が述べているように、親は学校の勉強や放課後の活動、精神面での支えに深く関わることが求められています。
toefl:se:409.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:409.explanation: be supposed to doで「〜することになっている、〜すべきとされる」という義務・期待を表す。
toefl:se:409.relatedInfo: are expected to be closely involved / are required to take part in
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:410.answer: Many families now have two working parents, so meeting these expectations while maintaining a full-time job can be exhausting.
toefl:se:410.fullSentence: Many families now have two working parents, so meeting these expectations while maintaining a full-time job can be exhausting.
keyPhrases: meeting these expectations while maintaining a full-time job
toefl:se:410.japanese: 今では両親が共働きである家庭も多く、フルタイムの仕事を続けながらこうした期待に応えることは非常に疲れることになりかねません。
toefl:se:410.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:410.explanation: while -ingで「〜しながら」と同時進行の状況を表す。
toefl:se:410.relatedInfo: both parents working / can be draining
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:411.answer: In the past, community members or extended family often helped more with child-rearing, but that support network has weakened in many places.
toefl:se:411.fullSentence: In the past, community members or extended family often helped more with child-rearing, but that support network has weakened in many places.
toefl:se:411.japanese: かつては地域の人々や親戚がもっと子育てを手伝ってくれることが多かったのですが、その支援ネットワークは多くの地域で弱まっています。
toefl:se:411.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:411.explanation: has weakenedは現在完了で過去から現在までの変化を表す。
toefl:se:411.relatedInfo: extended relatives / that network of support has declined
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:412.answer: Second, digital technology introduces new responsibilities.
toefl:se:412.fullSentence: Second, digital technology introduces new responsibilities.
toefl:se:412.japanese: 第二に、デジタル技術は新たな責任をもたらします。
toefl:se:412.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:412.explanation: introduceは「（新たなものを）もたらす、導入する」という意味。
toefl:se:412.relatedInfo: brings new responsibilities / creates additional duties
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:413.answer: Like Andrew says, apps and online courses give children excellent learning opportunities.
toefl:se:413.fullSentence: Like Andrew says, apps and online courses give children excellent learning opportunities.
toefl:se:413.japanese: アンドリューが言うように、アプリやオンライン講座は子どもたちに素晴らしい学習機会を与えてくれます。
toefl:se:413.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:413.explanation: like A saysは「Aが言うように」と口語的に引用する表現。
toefl:se:413.relatedInfo: as Andrew says / provide children with great learning opportunities
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:414.answer: However, parents must constantly monitor what their kids watch and how much time they spend online.
toefl:se:414.fullSentence: However, parents must constantly monitor what their kids watch and how much time they spend online.
keyPhrases: how much time they spend online
toefl:se:414.japanese: しかし、親は子どもが何を見ているか、そしてオンラインでどれくらいの時間を過ごしているかを常に監視しなければなりません。
toefl:se:414.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:414.explanation: must constantly doで「常に〜しなければならない」という強い義務を表す。
toefl:se:414.relatedInfo: have to keep watching / need to keep track of
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:415.answer: This is not just a technical task; it is also an emotional one.
toefl:se:415.fullSentence: This is not just a technical task; it is also an emotional one.
toefl:se:415.japanese: これは単なる技術的な作業ではなく、精神的な作業でもあります。
toefl:se:415.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:415.explanation: not just A; it is also Bで「Aだけでなく、Bでもある」という対比表現。oneはtask(仕事)を指す代名詞。
toefl:se:415.relatedInfo: not merely a technical matter / it is emotional as well
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:416.answer: As Claire points out, devices can interfere with parent–child communication, forcing parents to compete with screens for their children's attention.
toefl:se:416.fullSentence: As Claire points out, devices can interfere with parent–child communication, forcing parents to compete with screens for their children's attention.
keyPhrases: compete with screens for their children's attention
toefl:se:416.japanese: クレアが指摘するように、デバイスは親子のコミュニケーションを妨げることがあり、親は子どもの注意を引くために画面と競わざるを得なくなります。
toefl:se:416.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:416.explanation: forcing以下は分詞構文で結果を補足している。force A to doで「Aに〜せざるを得なくさせる」。
toefl:se:416.relatedInfo: as Claire notes / get in the way of parent-child communication
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:417.answer: For these reasons, although technology and modern resources can be helpful, the combination of higher expectations and digital distractions makes parenting more demanding than it used to be.
toefl:se:417.fullSentence: For these reasons, although technology and modern resources can be helpful, the combination of higher expectations and digital distractions makes parenting more demanding than it used to be.
keyPhrases: combination of higher expectations and digital distractions
more demanding than it used to be
toefl:se:417.japanese: これらの理由から、テクノロジーや現代的なリソースは役に立つこともありますが、より高い期待とデジタルの気を散らすものが組み合わさることで、子育ては以前よりも大変なものになっています。
toefl:se:417.topic: 子育てとデジタル技術
toefl:se:417.explanation: althoughは「〜だが」という譲歩を表す接続詞。than it used to beで「以前そうであったよりも」と過去との比較を示す。
toefl:se:417.relatedInfo: for these reasons, / harder than it once was
src: 子育てとデジタル技術2

toefl:se:418.answer: In my opinion, television advertising is becoming less influential for several reasons.
toefl:se:418.fullSentence: In my opinion, television advertising is becoming less influential for several reasons.
keyPhrases: becoming less influential for several reasons
toefl:se:418.japanese: 私の意見では、いくつかの理由からテレビ広告の影響力は低下してきています。
toefl:se:418.explanation: become less〜で「〜でなくなってきている」という変化を表す。
toefl:se:418.relatedInfo: In my view, / losing its influence for a number of reasons
src: テレビ広告の影響力1

toefl:se:419.answer: First, the amount of time people spend watching traditional TV shows is decreasing because many now watch videos or use apps on their smartphones, where online ads and product placements are more common.
toefl:se:419.fullSentence: First, the amount of time people spend watching traditional TV shows is decreasing because many now watch videos or use apps on their smartphones, where online ads and product placements are more common.
keyPhrases: amount of time people spend watching traditional tv shows is decreasing
online ads and product placements are more common
toefl:se:419.japanese: 第一に、多くの人が今ではスマートフォンで動画を見たりアプリを使ったりするようになっており、そこではオンライン広告や商品配置の方が一般的であるため、従来型のテレビ番組を見る時間は減少しています。
toefl:se:419.explanation: whereは場所ではなく「そしてそこでは」と状況を補足する関係副詞的用法。
toefl:se:419.relatedInfo: is on the decline / are more prevalent
src: テレビ広告の影響力1

toefl:se:420.answer: Second, television advertising is usually more expensive than advertising online, yet it may not reach the target audience as effectively.
toefl:se:420.fullSentence: Second, television advertising is usually more expensive than advertising online, yet it may not reach the target audience as effectively.
keyPhrases: may not reach the target audience as effectively
toefl:se:420.japanese: 第二に、テレビ広告は通常オンライン広告よりも費用が高いにもかかわらず、ターゲット層に同じくらい効果的に届くとは限りません。
toefl:se:420.explanation: yetは「それにもかかわらず」という逆接の等位接続詞。
toefl:se:420.relatedInfo: costs more than online advertising / may not be as effective at reaching
src: テレビ広告の影響力1

toefl:se:421.answer: With the rise of online platforms, people can find product reviews and information directly from other consumers, which makes them trust online resources more than TV ads.
toefl:se:421.fullSentence: With the rise of online platforms, people can find product reviews and information directly from other consumers, which makes them trust online resources more than TV ads.
keyPhrases: trust online resources more than tv ads
toefl:se:421.japanese: オンラインプラットフォームの台頭により、人々は他の消費者から直接商品レビューや情報を得られるようになり、そのためテレビ広告よりもオンラインの情報源を信頼するようになっています。
toefl:se:421.explanation: which以下は関係代名詞の非制限用法で前文全体を受けて結果を表す。
toefl:se:421.relatedInfo: with the growth of / rely more on online sources than television ads
src: テレビ広告の影響力1

toefl:se:422.answer: Therefore, I believe the influence of television advertising is getting weaker.
toefl:se:422.fullSentence: Therefore, I believe the influence of television advertising is getting weaker.
keyPhrases: influence of television advertising is getting weaker
toefl:se:422.japanese: したがって、テレビ広告の影響力は弱まってきていると私は考えます。
toefl:se:422.explanation: get weakerで「弱くなっていく」という変化を表す。
src: テレビ広告の影響力1

toefl:se:423.answer: I believe television advertising is becoming less influential, mainly because viewers no longer depend on it for product information or trust it as much as before.
toefl:se:423.fullSentence: I believe television advertising is becoming less influential, mainly because viewers no longer depend on it for product information or trust it as much as before.
keyPhrases: mainly because viewers no longer depend on it
trust it as much as before
toefl:se:423.japanese: 私は、視聴者がもはや商品情報をテレビ広告に頼らなくなり、以前ほど信頼もしなくなっているという理由から、テレビ広告の影響力は低下してきていると考えます。
toefl:se:423.explanation: mainly becauseで主な理由を提示する。no longer〜は「もはや〜ない」。
toefl:se:423.relatedInfo: primarily because / as much as they used to
src: テレビ広告の影響力2

toefl:se:424.answer: First, as Claire mentioned, many consumers begin their decision-making process online.
toefl:se:424.fullSentence: First, as Claire mentioned, many consumers begin their decision-making process online.
toefl:se:424.japanese: 第一に、クレアが述べていたように、多くの消費者は意思決定のプロセスをオンラインで始めます。
toefl:se:424.explanation: begin -ing/名詞で「〜を始める」。decision-making processは「意思決定の過程」。
toefl:se:424.relatedInfo: as Claire pointed out / start their decision-making online
src: テレビ広告の影響力2

toefl:se:425.answer: When I am interested in a product, I usually search for reviews, comparison videos, and user comments.
toefl:se:425.fullSentence: When I am interested in a product, I usually search for reviews, comparison videos, and user comments.
keyPhrases: search for reviews, comparison videos, and user comments
toefl:se:425.japanese: ある商品に興味を持ったとき、私は通常レビューや比較動画、利用者のコメントを検索します。
toefl:se:425.explanation: search for〜で「〜を探す、検索する」。
toefl:se:425.relatedInfo: look up reviews and comparison videos
src: テレビ広告の影響力2

toefl:se:426.answer: These sources provide detailed, up-to-date, and often critical information that a 30-second TV commercial simply cannot match.
toefl:se:426.fullSentence: These sources provide detailed, up-to-date, and often critical information that a 30-second TV commercial simply cannot match.
keyPhrases: provide detailed, up-to-date, and often critical information
toefl:se:426.japanese: これらの情報源は、30秒のテレビコマーシャルではとても太刀打ちできないほど、詳細で最新かつしばしば批判的な情報を提供してくれます。
toefl:se:426.explanation: that以下はinformationを修飾する関係代名詞節。simply cannot matchで「到底かなわない」という強調。
toefl:se:426.relatedInfo: offer in-depth and current information / can't come close to
src: テレビ広告の影響力2
